reason: The source-study BDI-II remains licensed and is not reproduced. PHQ-9 is administered as a distinct validated alternative for depressive symptoms and must never be treated as a BDI-II score.

scoring.safety_rule: Any response above 0 to item 9 requires direct human safety assessment under the applicable study protocol; it is not an automated suicide-risk classification.
